Image 1 is the exact original identity and composition reference; image 2 is the approved rendering-style reference ONLY, do not copy its subject. Do not preserve the magenta background, white borders or legacy board. Native square 1254x1254 required. Render directly with true RGBA transparent background and transparent empty gaps, no colored backing, floor, shadow blob, frame, card or checkerboard drawing. No readable letters, numbers, invented names, labels, faction symbols or watermark. Preserve opaque object cores and clean naturally antialiased alpha edges; no translucent object surfaces. Preserve ALL original object parts; simplify surface noise only.
Subject invariants: open worn casualty ledger seen in three-quarter view with two cream parchment pages, brown heavy cover, dark iron corner plates, right-side fastening strap, thickness of stacked pages. Keep columns of individual record rows on BOTH pages, represented ONLY by simple short nonverbal strokes and small record dots, no real or fictional writing. Preserve the original five attached marker/tab shapes: a small gray tab protrudes at upper left, an ochre hanging-hole tag protrudes at upper right, one blue-gray identity tag hangs from left edge, two overlapping light-tan and ochre tags hang at lower center. Keep all their cord connections. One separate dark graphite/charcoal pencil lies diagonally along lower-right, pointing upper-right, with visible pale sharpened wood tip and dark lead. Keep pencil distinct with a transparent gap from book. Same book orientation and parts as image1; no quill, closed book, skull, blood, new insignia or invented symbol. Broad matte parchment and chunky outlines.
